added_failures_note: Derived from the reviewed run's own baseline_suite and after_suite: base ids (4) minus head ids (2) leaves tests/standard_names/test_export_layout_stamp.py::test_publish_accepts_the_installed_package_value as the only head-only id; suite-head2.log:143 shows it is 'Failed: Timeout (>30.0s) from pytest-timeout' inside a git init subprocess at fixture setup, and serial-rerun.log:14 records it passing in 0.72 s, so it is a load artefact rather than a code failure and no code-attributable failure id was added.

findings.text: A STRUCT_ARRAY resolves to b.source_id + '/values' by string construction without a graph lookup, so when that leaf node is absent the row carries source_id equal to the leaf string, passes the null check at line 450, and the MERGE at line 497 matches nothing: the path is neither bound nor reported, which is the silent drop the deliverable forbids.
